title: Periodic Solutions for a Nonlinear Dirac Equation with Soler-Type Nonlinearity
summary: We study nonlinear Dirac equations on the three-dimensional torus with subcritical Soler-type nonlinearities. The variational problem is strongly indefinite, while the non-coercive Soler potential prevents direct compactness. We recover the Palais--Smale condition by introducing a small coercive perturbation. Refined spectral estimates and a linking argument yield perturbed solutions with uniform energy bounds.
